notes:
I don't have any notes for you this time. The rules say I can only report what pages I actually read, and I didn't manage to read any.

I tried to fetch six verse-by-verse sources (listed below), but my script crashed. It read the reply from the first site in the wrong format. When I tried again to inspect that reply, I had hit the limit on tool calls for this turn. So no page content came back. Filling in from my own knowledge of these commentaries would break your rules, so I've written nothing.

If you ask again, here is what I'd work through:

**Main readings (all verses)**
- Enduring Word: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/daniel-6/
- Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/daniel/6.htm
- Gill: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/daniel/6.htm
- Pulpit Commentary: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/daniel/6.htm
- Precept Austin: https://www.preceptaustin.org/daniel-6-commentary

**Where Protestant traditions differ**
I'd search the tradition sites (Ligonier, Desiring God, GTY, Seedbed, Wesley Center, 1517/LCMS, Pneuma Review/AG) on three points:
- v. 10: whether Daniel's prayer is a model for civil disobedience, and what his kneeling and facing Jerusalem mean
- v. 22: the angel
- v. 24: why the accusers' wives and children were punished too

**Other views**
- NET Bible notes: https://netbible.org/bible/Daniel+6
- Bible Odyssey on who "Darius the Mede" was (vv. 1, 28) and the book's date
- New Advent (Catholic Encyclopedia and Church Fathers) and Catholic.com on Daniel and the lions' den, including the Catholic deuterocanonical story of Bel and the Dragon, where Daniel is also put in a lions' den
- OCA on how the Orthodox Church remembers the Prophet Daniel
- Got Questions on Darius the Mede and on any prosperity-teaching readings of v. 28

Reply and I'll fetch these and write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point and only what the pages actually say.
